Team for this one: me and Jarvis, plus Eleanor for a go check because item 3 involves spending money and outside people. Not needed: everyone else. One set for Mon 16 to Fri 20 Nov:
1. Mon to Tue: #71 Unity and #66 Firebase. Both were due 15 Nov, sprint 1 started today, and Sofia, Aisha and Tessa can't start real tickets (including #164) until they exist. Ravi and Aisha will walk you through each.
2. Wed: 30 minutes with Grant on #72, the Alpha Sprint Plan, with #151 (25-level alpha) so sprint 1 scope locks. In the same sitting, give the #143 master doc OK and upload database v26 in place of v25 (#15).
3. Thu to Fri: Gate 0. Book the attorney (#73) and the accountant (#74), and open the business bank account and card (#2), which must be done before the 12 Dec Claude Max renewal.
Everything else, such as Morgan's #119 hire call and the #106 art pilot, waits for next week unless you say otherwise.

Eleanor, Legal & Compliance, here. I'm not a lawyer. Go on #73: book a Colorado-licensed startup or games attorney, and bring the Attorney Meeting Brief so every question gets covered in one meeting. Go on #74 and #2 as well: the LLC is active and the EIN is done, so the bank account can be in the company's name. Keep business and personal money separate from day one. For both bookings, get the fee in writing before you commit, and have Benjamin log it. Not yet on anything waiting for the attorney's review, such as switching on the website sign-up form.

Jarvis here. All three are already HIGH on the list, and four of them (#66, #71, #72, #143) were due Sunday 15 Nov. #52 GitHub and #82 Slack were ticked done, so they drop off this week's set. The hard date to watch is #2 before 12 Dec. Noted for the to-do list: add a 'Week of 16 Nov: top 3' line under 'For you first': (1) #71 and #66, (2) #72 with #151, plus the #143 OK and v26 upload, (3) #73, #74 and #2.
